name: outubro
description: Outubro Idiomas — a language school's site rebuilt in PT/EN/ES around its own verb, destravar. Localized URLs, GSAP + Lenis motion, CMS-ready content seams.

paragraphs: A rebuild of Outubro Idiomas' website in Portuguese, English and Spanish, built around the brand's own verb: destravar (to unstick). Outubro Idiomas teaches English, French, Spanish and German to Brazilian working adults in live online classes. The brand had already redrawn its name, colours and mark; the old site had the right content and none of the brand.

Status (2026-09-28). Every page is built in three languages: the full Home plus Preços, Método, Depoimentos, FAQ, Contato, Trabalhe conosco and a draft Política de privacidade (TASK-pages-static.md), aligned to the client's brandbook. Pricing, FAQ and testimonials read Payload-shaped stand-ins until Payload is installed (TASK-scaffold.md, then TASK-cms). Testimonials are openly placeholder cards. Copy marked [CONTENT] in content/home/.ts, content/pages/ and lib/faqs.ts is draft wording pending docs/client-content-request.md (EN/ES are unreviewed translations). The approved planning document…
features: A signature interaction from the brand's word. A doodled cord untangles as the hero
headline resolves, and língua lands as the cord straightens — destravar drawn literally, not a generic unlock icon.
Mobile-first motion. Most visitors arrive from WhatsApp on a phone, so motion is GSAP
Lenis (tier 2) in small client leaves, and WebGL is deliberately left out.
